Democratic incumbent [[Bob Kerrey]] declined to run for a third term in office. Former governor [[Ben Nelson]] won the open seat over [[Don Stenberg]]. Nelson won despite Republican presidential nominee [[George W. Bush]] carrying the state in a landslide in the [[2000 United States presidential election in Nebraska|concurrent presidential election]]. {{As of|2026}}, this is the last time Nebraska voted for a Senate candidate and a presidential candidate of different political parties. == Democratic primary == === Candidates === * [[Ben Nelson]], former [[List of governors of Nebraska|governor of
